observations.body: The believers are one in heart and soul, hold possessions for common use, hear resurrection witness with power, and distribute proceeds according to need.
observations.label: One heart, apostolic witness, and shared property continue

observations.body: The passage presents Witnessing, selling, bringing, and distributing as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Witnessing, selling, bringing, and distributing

observations.body: The passage places Believers, apostles, and Barnabas beside Witnessing, selling, bringing, and distributing.
observations.label: Believers, apostles, and Barnabas

payload.posture: Read Acts 4:32–37 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the believers are one in heart and soul, hold possessions for common use, hear resurrection witness with power, and distribute proceeds according to need. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: One heart, apostolic witness, and shared property continue
